name: Music Assistant
author: oparada1988
short_description: Connect to your Music Assistant server and control playlists, playback, and volume at the press of a button.
description:
Connect directly to your Music Assistant (v2+) server natively in Rust to manage your playlists, favorite music, and players with real-time WebSocket updates.

Launch playlists with live cover artwork, control playback and volume from LCD keys or Stream Deck + dials, and access all your connected music providers effortlessly.

actions.name: Now Playing & Volume
actions.description: Live album art, track info, rotary volume & touchscreen skip zones

actions.name: Play Playlist
actions.description: Launch any Music Assistant playlist with live cover art on the key

actions.name: Volume / Mute
actions.description: Adjust player volume with rotary dial and press to toggle mute

actions.name: Play / Pause
actions.description: Live state-aware play/pause toggle with optional dial volume

actions.name: Play
actions.description: Resume playback on target or active player

actions.name: Pause
actions.description: Pause active playback on target player

actions.name: Stop
actions.description: Stop active playback on target player

actions.name: Next Track
actions.description: Skip to next track in the player queue

actions.name: Previous Track
actions.description: Return to previous track in the player queue

actions.name: Volume Up
actions.description: Increase target player volume by a configurable step

actions.name: Volume Down
actions.description: Decrease target player volume by a configurable step
